label: Security-gap SaaS (US/EU)
positioning: SMB / mid-market SaaS companies that ship a real product to real customers but have no dedicated security engineer. They hit a wall the first time an enterprise prospect sends a security questionnaire or demands SOC 2. Wedge: AppSec assessment + DevSecOps pipeline, sold by an engineer who builds, not an auditor who only reports.

must_have: web-facing SaaS product with a login
sells B2B (has enterprise customers to lose)

disqualifiers.unreachable: No response from the public homepage; nothing was observed, so nothing can be claimed
disqualifiers.is_security_vendor: Sells security themselves; the pitch is insulting
disqualifiers.has_security_team: In-house security function already; we'd be displacing, not filling
disqualifiers.enterprise_scale: Over ~400 staff: procurement cycle too long for an agency this size

csp.why: No Content-Security-Policy — the loudest AppSec tell on a login-bearing app

trust_page.why: No /security or /trust page — cannot answer an enterprise security review

compliance_claim.why: No SOC 2 / ISO 27001 claim anywhere public — the deal-blocker they haven't hit yet

security_txt.why: No /.well-known/security.txt — no disclosure process, no named security owner

hsts.why: No Strict-Transport-Security — trivially fixed, always flagged in questionnaires

outdated_js.why: Known-outdated JS library served in production — concrete, demonstrable

server_banner.why: Server / X-Powered-By header discloses stack and version

referrer_policy.why: No Referrer-Policy — leaks internal URLs to third parties

scoring.note: Normalise to 0-100 over the weights of OBSERVED signals only. An unobserved signal is excluded from both the numerator and the denominator, so a blocked fetch can never become a fake finding.

freshness.note: Findings older than 14 days are marked stale and must be re-verified before appearing in any outbound draft.

outreach.opener_rule: Lead with ONE specific, verifiable finding on their own public product, stated plainly and without alarmism. One finding, one consequence, one ask. Never send a numeric score. Never imply anything private was accessed.
outreach.note: Cold voice and cold SMS are deliberately absent and are not addable here. Voice and SMS are for inbound contacts and contacts with a recorded opt-in only, enforced in the send path, not in this document.
